title: Lantern Valley
world: A miniature valley where a lighthouse keeps a footbridge visible at night.

characters.name: Pip
characters.role: A curious courier who learns to test before rushing
characters.signature: One short antenna and teal messenger satchel

characters.name: Ada
characters.signature: Two antenna tips and copper tool belt

continuity: Pip and Ada live in Lantern Valley.
The lighthouse is powered by a small amber light capsule.
